facts.fact: The PDPO's decision of 20 February 2026 partly upheld a complaint against WhatsApp LLC and Meta Platforms, Inc. and ordered, within 90 days, a revised Uganda privacy policy, separation of core and ancillary processing with opt-in, a Regulation 30 adequacy assessment, an intra-group DPIA and a legitimate-interests assessment.
